# Notepads Markdown RaTeX fork

Fixed RaTeX 0.1.15 source and original licenses are retained. Local bounded execution,
storage and static-table changes are described in the module FORKS.md.

Product adapter: `crates/markdown-math/`. Current notices and font identities:
`third-party-notices/MarkdownCore/`, `third-party-notices/NativeMath/` and
`crates/markdown-math/assets/ASSETS.json`.

Run `scripts/Test-Rust.ps1 -Layer Math` from the module root. The original legacy
APIs remain for compatibility tests; supported input and execution controls belong
to the bounded adapter. Original copyrights and licenses remain applicable.
